title: Postgres LISTEN/NOTIFY actually scales
summary: This article explores the real-world scalability of PostgreSQL's LISTEN/NOTIFY mechanism, challenging the common misconception that it doesn't scale well. The author provides benchmarks and practical insights on how to effectively use this feature for real-time event notifications in production systems.
problem_solved: Addresses the widespread belief that PostgreSQL's LISTEN/NOTIFY feature is not scalable, providing evidence-based analysis of its actual performance characteristics.
why_valuable: It provides empirical data and practical guidance for developers who might avoid a useful PostgreSQL feature due to perceived scalability limitations, enabling better architectural decisions.
